narrative: Today's batch is dominated by fire and connectivity themes: a Conservation Biology paper distils lessons from Australia's Black Summer bushfires for integrating biodiversity protection into emergency response, while a Global Change Biology study documents a multi-decadal shift in the Pantanal's fire regime as hydroclimatic coupling weakens. Movement and connectivity work spans Arctic sea-ice-dependent polar bears showing strong site fidelity despite range-edge pressure, and a range-wide jaguar connectivity model flagging major corridor fragmentation in Mexico and Central America. On the trophic and herbivory side, invasive freshwater fish are shown to disrupt size-spectrum and predator-prey mass ratio relationships, while UV-B exposure interacts with silicon supplementation to reshape anti-herbivore defence allocation in cereals. Invasion biology features prominently: Spartina alterniflora shows rapid evolutionary divergence in growth-defence trait syndromes between native and introduced ranges, and loss of litter allelochemicals is linked to facilitation among co-invading alien species. Symbiosis research highlights dark septate endophytes outcompeting arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi in wheat, and reciprocal carbon-nitrogen exchange through grassland hyphospheres. On the applied side, a Journal of Applied Ecology study shows peatland rewetting after decades of forestry drainage is restoring specialist vegetation and peat accumulation, and several new passive-acoustic methods papers push efficiency gains for bioacoustic species monitoring.

methods_radar.title: The PhenoChange network protocol for monitoring leaf phenology in tropical dry ecosystems using phenocameras
methods_radar.note: Introduces the PhenoChange phenocamera network protocol for standardised monitoring of tropical dry forest phenology.

methods_radar.title: ESO: An evolutionary algorithm for efficient model reduction via automated frequency band selection in passive acoustic monitoring
methods_radar.note: Introduces ESO, a new evolutionary algorithm automating frequency-band selection to cut computational cost of acoustic classifiers.

methods_radar.title: Contrastive ecoacoustic indices: Large‐scale global soundscape characterization with contrastive inference
methods_radar.note: Introduces contrastive language-audio pretraining (CLAP) as a new approach to global soundscape characterisation.

methods_radar.title: An efficient Bayesian phylogenetic approach for joint inference of continuous and discrete trait evolution under a state‐dependent Ornstein–Uhlenbeck model
methods_radar.note: Introduces a new Bayesian phylogenetic method for joint inference under a state-dependent Ornstein-Uhlenbeck model.

methods_radar.title: Novel class identification: A human‐in‐the‐loop approach for efficient species recognition in bioacoustic data
methods_radar.note: Introduces novel class identification, a new machine-learning task for efficiently flagging rare species in bioacoustic data.

methods_radar.title: Observer coverage and interaction rates determine the choice between design‐based and machine learning bycatch estimators for rare species
methods_radar.note: Compares design-based and machine-learning bycatch estimators to determine which performs better for rare species.

methods_radar.title: Using Integrated Species Distribution Models to Improve Range Size Metrics for IUCN Red List Assessments
methods_radar.note: Evaluates integrated species distribution models against presence-only SDMs for more rigorous IUCN Red List range metrics.

methods_radar.title: N‐SDM 2.0: a reengineered software with extended features for nested species distribution modelling
methods_radar.note: Presents N-SDM 2.0, a reengineered software package with extended features for nested species distribution modelling.

methods_radar.title: Hierarchical Modelling of Aquatic Species Distributions
methods_radar.note: Develops novel hierarchical global-to-regional model structures advancing species distribution modelling for aquatic systems.

methods_radar.title: Including linear landscape elements improves fine-scale species distribution models of bees and hoverflies
methods_radar.note: Advances fine-scale species distribution models by incorporating linear landscape elements, improving prediction accuracy for pollinators.

methods_radar.title: Using full annual cycle species distribution models to predict abundance change in migratory birds
methods_radar.note: Advances species distribution modelling by incorporating full annual-cycle conditions rather than breeding-season data alone.

methods_radar.title: Enhanced fish detection sensitivity in aquatic systems using environmental RNA
methods_radar.note: Evaluates environmental RNA as an advance on established eDNA methods, offering faster signal decay and physiological insight.

methods_radar.title: Discovering the unseen: A performance comparison of taxonomic classification methods for unknown DNA barcodes
methods_radar.note: Benchmarks taxonomic classification methods for unidentified DNA barcodes against incomplete reference databases.

methods_radar.title: An Interpretable Machine Learning Approach to Ecologically Characterize Soil Carbon and Structure From Multi‐Kingdom Microbiome, Texture and Climate
methods_radar.note: Evaluates interpretable machine learning using multi-kingdom microbiome data to predict soil structural and carbon properties.

methods_radar.title: Environmental DNA Reveals Distinct Regions of Extraordinary Marine Biodiversity to Inform a Newly Established Marine Park—Exmouth Gulf, Western Australia
methods_radar.note: Applies environmental DNA, an established method, to characterise marine biodiversity informing a new marine park's zoning.

methods_radar.title: Use of a Bayesian Hierarchical Density Surface Model to Estimate Seasonal Distributions of Large Whales Off the East Coast of the United States With an Application to a Wind Energy Area
methods_radar.note: Applies Bayesian hierarchical density surface models to estimate whale distributions relevant to offshore wind planning.

methods_radar.title: Linking species distribution models with population abundance to support adaptive fisheries management
methods_radar.note: Applies species distribution models linked with abundance data to support adaptive fisheries management of anchovy stocks.

methods_radar.title: Colombian Caribbean mammals: A dataset of the wild mammal assemblage in the Colombian Caribbean region
methods_radar.note: Compiles a large camera-trap dataset using an established survey method to document mammal assemblages.

methods_radar.title: Facilitating macrosystem biology with organismal‐scale airborne remote sensing: Challenges and opportunities
methods_radar.note: A perspective reviewing applications and challenges of organismal-scale airborne remote sensing for macrosystem biology.

methods_radar.title: Divergent Temporal Trends in Carbon Assimilation‐Growth Coupling Across Global Forests
methods_radar.note: Applies partial correlation and machine-learning approaches to analyse forest carbon-growth coupling trends; not itself a methods contribution.

methods_radar.title: Range Maps and Occurrence Data Support Conflicting Biogeographical Hypotheses About Australian Amphibians
methods_radar.note: Compares range maps against occurrence records, existing data sources, to test biogeographical hypotheses for Australian amphibians.

methods_radar.title: Rapid loss, and slow recovery, of coral reef structural complexity resulting from a prolonged marine heatwave
methods_radar.note: Applies Structure-from-Motion photogrammetry, an established technique, to track coral reef structural complexity over time.

methods_radar.title: Elements on the move: How ungulate migration expands Alpine biogeochemical footprints
methods_radar.note: Applies GPS telemetry and a spatially explicit model to quantify nutrient transport by migratory ungulates.

methods_radar.title: Birds and bats differ in pest control pathways in fruit orchards: Intraguild and direct predation
methods_radar.note: Applies dietary DNA metabarcoding, an established technique, to build tri-trophic predation networks in orchards.

methods_radar.title: Multispecies Genomics Uncovers a Common Legacy of Postglacial Isolation on a Neotropical Land‐Bridge Island
methods_radar.note: Uses RAD-seq genomic data with Approximate Bayesian Computation and machine learning to test demographic divergence hypotheses.

methods_radar.title: Shifting Yet Persisting? Multiple Dimensions of Habitat Suitability Change in Northeast Atlantic Cetaceans
methods_radar.note: Applies Bayesian additive regression tree models to project future cetacean habitat suitability under climate scenarios.

methods_radar.title: Leveraging time-series remote sensing to predict post-fire invasive annual grass response in western US rangelands

methods_radar.title: Intermediate habitat fragmentation reduces gastropod movement in experimental intertidal landscapes: implications for fragmentation-diversity relationships
methods_radar.note: Uses drone surveys and mark-recapture, established field methods, to quantify fragmentation effects on gastropod movement.

methods_radar.title: Flexible use of conserved motifs constrains genome access in cell type evolution
methods_radar.note: Applies deep-learning models to single-nucleus multi-omic sequencing data to study regulatory motif evolution across cell types.
